source: 656 Choosing a Reward
target: 656 Praemium Eligendo

source: Lumian once again encountered Monsieur Iveljsta, who resided in B18.
target: Lumian iterum convenit Domino Iveljsta, qui in B18 habitabat.

source: He still wore a fluffy black hat adorned with a white feather and a complex black robe.
target: Adhuc gerebat pileum nigrum lanuginosum, alba plumula ornatum, atque vestem nigrum intricatum.

source: With a quick glance, Lumian had already covertly used Weakness Investigation to search for pale‐white marks on Iveljsta’s body, ready for potential assassinations and surprise attacks.
target: Celeriter intuens, Lumian iam occulte "Investigatio Infirmitatis" ad maculas pallide-albas in corpore Iveljsta quaerendum adhibuerat, paratus ad furtivas caedes et inopinatas incursiones.

source: Aurore and Emperor Roselle had always emphasized the need to stay vigilant against others at all times!
target: Aurore et Imperator Roselle semper extollerunt necessitatem contra ceteros in omnibus temporibus vigilare!

source: Of course, Lumian felt that the two of them hadn’t done a good job in this matter.
target: Certe, Lumian sensit hos duos in hac re non bene gessisse.

source: Otherwise, they would still be active in the world.
target: Alioquin, adhuc in mundo versarentur.

source: At that moment, the pallor on Iveljsta’s body concentrated on his dark-brown eyes, emitting an illusory quality that seemed unreal.
target: At eo tempore, pallor in corpore Iveljsta in oculos eius fuscos brunneos se concentrabat, emittens qualitatem illusoriam, quae quasi irrealis videbatur.

source: Does this mean he can quickly transform into a Wraith, and his eyes are no longer his weakness?
target: An hoc significat eum celeriter in Umbra transformari posse, et oculos eius non iam esse ejus infirmitatem?

source: As Lumian pondered, he gestured towards the divan in the living room.
target: Dum Lumian meditabatur, ad divanum in conclavi indicavit.

source: “Let’s chat there.”
target: Ibi colloquamur.

source: Ludwig, seated at the dining table, glanced at Iveljsta for a few seconds before lowering his head and continuing his meal with a succulent piece of beef.
target: Ludwig, ad mensam cenandi sedens, paucos momenta in Iveljsta aspexit antequam caput inclinaret et cenam edere pergebat cum frusto bubulae succulentae.

source: Iveljsta nodded slightly and entered the living room quietly, taking a seat in a corner of the divan.
target: Iveljsta leviter annuit et tranquille in conclavi intravit, sedens in angulo divani.

source: Are you a student at a primary school? So disciplined…
target: Esne discipulus scholae primariae? Quam disciplinae te geris!

source: Lumian criticized as he focused on observing Iverista’s luck.
target: Lumian reprehendit, dum fortunam Iverista observabat.

source: It was relatively normal and nothing special.
target: Ita erat plane ordinarium et nihil speciale.

source: At that moment, Lumian suddenly had a few thoughts.
target: At eo tempore, Lumian subito aliquas cogitationes habuit.

source: Luck Observation and Weakness Investigation require the eyes to determine the target’s color.
target: Observatio Fortunae et Investigatio Infirmitatis oculos requirunt ut colorem scopī determinent.

source: However, one focuses on the background color, while the other captures the various colors on the surface of the body.
target: Attamen, unus ad colorem ambitus intendit, dum alter diversas colores in superficie corporis observat.

source: When I become a Fate Appropriator, could these two abilities fuse and mutate into a more special ability?
target: Si ego fati adeptor fiam, num hae duae facultates confluere atque in facultatem specialem mutari possint?

source: Why can I only use my eyes to observe these two abilities?
target: Cur solum oculos meos ad has duas facultates observandas uti possum?

source: Is a blind Reaper incapable of attacking a target’s weakness?
target: Num caecus Messor non valeat oppugnare infirmitatem scopī?

source: Similarly, is a blind Ascetic unqualified to observe others’ luck?
target: Similiter, num caecus Asceticus non idoneus sit ad aliorum fortunam observandam?

source: Can’t they rely on their spirituality and ears and nose?
target: Nonne possunt in spiritualitate sua, auribus, et naso inniti?

source: Or could it be done at a higher Sequence?
target: An id fieri potest in sequentia superiori?

source: Lumian eased into the armchair, positioning himself at an angle across from Iveljsta.
target: Lumian se leniter in sella relaxata instituit, se in angulo opposito a Iveljsta ponens.

source: Flashing a friendly smile, he asked, “What’s the matter?”
target: Risu amico scintillante, quaesivit: "Quid agitur?"

source: He spoke in Intisian.
target: Loquebatur in Intisiana.

source: Iveljsta, as silent as a corpse, straightened up.
target: Iveljsta, tam silens quam cadaver, se recte erexit.

source: His eyes, deep as he spoke in ancient Feysac.
target: Oculi eius, profundi, cum in antiqua Feysac loqueretur.

source: “Allow me to introduce myself. Iveljsta Eggers, a member of the Rose School of Thought and temperance faction under the Church of The Fool.”
target: Permitte mihi me ipsum præsentare. Ego sum Iveljsta Eggers, membrum Scholae Sententiarum Rosae et factionis Temperantiae sub Ecclesia Stulti.

source: Lumian’s nerves, already tense, heightened.
target: Nervi Lumiani, iam tensi, augeri coeperunt.

source: Nevertheless, he maintained a relaxed demeanor, confirming, "Are you Twanaku’s liaison?"
target: Tamen, animo relaxato servavit, confirmans: "Esne legatus Twanaku?"

source: He switched to ancient Feysac.
target: Mutavit ad antiquam Feysac.

source: “No,” Iveljsta shook his head, “I’ve already eliminated that member fifteen minutes ago.”
target: "Non," inquit Iveljsta, capite movente, "iam illum membrum quindecim minutis abhinc exstirpsi."

source: Fifteen minutes ago, when I was still with the patrol team…
target: Quindecim minutis abhinc, cum adhuc cum turma vigiliarum essem…

source: However, you can’t expect me to believe you just because you say so…
target: Tamen, non potes exspectare ut id credam, quoniam ita dixeris…

source: Lumian feigned curiosity and asked, “I recall that you arrived in Port Pylos before Twanaku was exposed. What was your original motive?”
target: Lumian, curiositatem fingens, rogavit: "Memini te in Portu Pylos adveneris antequam Twanaku patefactus esset. Quid fuit propositum tuum initio?"

source: “I’m investigating the primitive forest in this area. I’m still in the early stages of gathering more information,” Iveljsta replied seriously.
target: "Exploro silvam primitivam huius regionis. Adhuc in initio sum plura informationes colligendi," respondit Iveljsta serio.

source: “Four days ago, I came into contact with Twanaku and obtained some information from him.
target: "Quattuor die abhinc, cum Twanaku conveniens, ab eo nonnullas informationes accepi.

source: He seemed fine and was very restrained.
target: Videbatur bene et erat valde temperatus.

source: He’s indeed restrained. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be a second serial murder case in Port Pylos only after four years…
target: Vere moderatus est. Alioquin non esset secunda caedes serialis in Portu Pylos nisi post quattuor annos…

source: Going to the primitive forest to investigate… The primitive forest…
target: Ire in silvam primitivam ad investigandum… Silva primitiva…

source: On the surface, the incident in Tizamo Town was a sudden attack by a tribe in the primitive forest.
target: Superficialiter, res in oppido Tizamo fuit repentina impetus a tribu in silva primitiva.

source: Lumian quickly made many connections and said to Iveljsta thoughtfully, “Twanaku once did something in Tizamo Town that involved the tribes in the nearby primitive forest. Some of his important items seem to be hidden in Tizamo Town. It might also be related to a Nois family Demon of unknown Sequence.”
target: Lumian celeriter multas nexiones fingens, cogitato loquens ad Iveljsta, dixit: "Twanaku olim aliquid egit in oppido Tizamo, quod tribus in silva primitiva proxima implicavit. Quaedam eius res maximi momenti videntur in oppido Tizamo celatae esse. Forsitan etiam ad Daemoni familiae Nois, cuius sequentia ignota est, attinet."

source: Iveljsta listened in silence, lost in thought.
target: Iveljsta silentio auscultavit, cogitatione amissus.

source: After a few seconds, he said to Lumian, “Thank you for providing this information. It might not be useful for my investigation, but it can let me know what to be wary of.”
target: Post paucos secundos, ad Lumian dixit: "Gratias tibi ago pro hisce informationibus. Forsitan in mea inquisitione non operabuntur, sed mihi ostendere possunt quid cavendum sit."

source: He didn’t specify his mission. Clearly, he needed his superior’s permission.
target: Non suam missionem definitus est. Manifestum est eum licentiam superioris habere necessariam.

source: Lumian responded nonchalantly, “Even if I don’t tell you now, you’ll find out tonight or tomorrow.”
target: Lumian leviter respondit: "Etiamsi nunc non dico, hac nocte aut cras cognosces."

source: Having already reported the matter to Madam Magician, the Major Arcana card holder would undoubtedly inform the Church of The Fool and the temperance faction in detail subsequently. It wouldn’t only be a general outline that mentioned key personnel like before.
target: Iam rem ad Dominam Magician referentem, possessor tabularum Major Arcana, indubitanter postea Ecclesiam Stulti et factionem Temperantiae in detail certiorem faciet. Non esset solum conspectus generalis, in quo principales personae, ut antea, memoratae fuerunt.

source: Iveljsta nodded with restraint and said, “I’m here to express my gratitude and to inform you that we’re already investigating any potential problems and latent dangers.
target: Iveljsta cum moderata more annuit et dixit: "Adsum ut gratiam meam exprimam et ut tibi referam nos iam quaestiones potentiales atque pericula latentia investigare.

source: “Also, if you need help in Matani, feel free to come to me.”
target: "Etiam, si auxilio in Matani indiges, libere ad me accede."

source: “Alright.” Lumian didn’t stand on ceremony.
target: "Bene." Lumian caerimoniam non servavit.

source: After delving into the more serious matters, Lumian, intrigued, asked Iveljsta, “Why did you add the Rose School of Thought prefix when you introduced yourself? You’ve already left the Rose School of Thought and joined the Church of The Fool. It sounds as if the Rose School of Thought is affiliated with the Church of The Fool.”
target: Postquam in quaestiones graviores versatus est, Lumian, admiratus, Iveljsta interrogavit: "Cur praefixum Scholae Sententiarum Rosae adiecisti cum te præsentare? Iam Scholae Sententiarum Rosae discessisti et Ecclesiam Stulti accessisti. Sonat quasi Scholae Sententiarum Rosae cum Ecclesia Stulti coniungatur."

source: “Our leader specifically requested this. She always believes that we are the true orthodox branch of the Rose School of Thought. Only we represent the Rose School of Thought. Those traitors should change the organization’s name, not us,” Iveljsta explained in detail.
target: "Ductrix nostra hoc specialiter postulavit. Illa semper credit nos esse veram orthodoxam partem Scholae Sententiarum Rosae. Soli nos ipsi Scholae Sententiarum Rosae repraesentamus. Illos proditores nomen organisationis mutare debent, non nos," Iveljsta enixe explicavit.

source: Sounds quite stubborn… Aren’t you from the temperance faction? Don’t you restrain your emotions and desires in this aspect?
target: Valde pertinax sonat… Nonne es ex factione Temperantiae? Nonne mores tuos et desideria in hoc respici temperas?

source: Yes, Sequence 5 is Wraith, close to evil spirits, and evil spirits have an extreme side.
target: Ita, Sequencia 5 est Umbra, vicina spiritibus malis, et spiritus mali partem extremam habent.

source: Is this reflected in High-Sequence Beyonders of the temperance faction’s corresponding pathway?
target: Num hoc in Beyonders Sequenciae Altae, viae factionis Temperantiae correspondentis, manifestum est?

source: Lumian didn’t quite understand and tried to make a guess based on the available information.
target: Lumian non plene intellexit et conatus est ex informationibus praesto aliquam coniecturam facere.

source: He was just chatting and had no intention of inquiring further.
target: Solum colloquium agebat et nullum studium ulterioris inquisitionis habebat.

source: Instead, he asked,
target: Proinde, interrogavit:

source: “Your last name is Eggers. Was your ancestor a member of the Balam Empire’s royal family?”
target: "Cognomen tuum est Eggers. Num maior tuus antecessor membrum regiae familiae Imperii Balam fuisse?"

source: “Yes,” Iveljsta replied proudly, his emotions held in check.
target: "Ita," respondit Iveljsta, superbus animos moderans.

source: “And my mother’s lineage is noble from the Highlands Kingdom.”
target: "Et stirps matris meae ex Regno Altorum nobilis est."

source: For many in the Southern Continent, the surname Eggers bore unparalleled prestige.
target: Multis in Continente Meridionali, cognomen Eggers praestantiam inimitabilem portabat.

source: It was a symbol of a deity who had once trod the land, a representation of Death’s dominion over the world.
target: Erat symbolum deī, qui olim terram calcaverat, et repraesentatio dominationis Mortis super mundum.

source: But Lumian’s curiosity wandered elsewhere.
target: Sed curiositas Lumiani alio loco erravit.

source: “I’ve heard that the mausoleums of the Balam Empire’s nobles are constructed upside down underground, much like this hotel.
target: "Audivi mausolea nobilium Imperii Balam sub terra, inversa, aedificari, sicut hoc deversorium.

source: What mystical significance does that hold?
target: Quid significat hoc mysticum?

source: Is it simply a way to confront death?
target: Num hoc solum modus est ad mortem oppugnandam?

source: And why is death associated with the underground?
target: Et cur mors cum subterraneo coniungitur?

source: Shouldn’t the Underworld exist in the spirit world?
target: Num non debet infernum in mundo spirituum exsistere?

source: This was the question that piqued Lumian’s interest upon learning about the matter.
target: Haec quaestio fuit quae Lumiani studium excitavit, cum de re didicerit.

source: His understanding of mysticism was limited.
target: Intelligentia eius de mysticis rebus limitata erat.

source: Iveljsta pondered for a moment and then explained,
target: Iveljsta paulisper cogitavit, deinde explicavit,

source: “I didn’t choose the Death pathway. The construction method originated from ancient times, passed down by all the Eggers ancestors, devoted to the deity who controlled death.
target: "Non elegi viam Mortis. Methodus aedificandi ex temporibus antiquis orta est, a cunctis maioribus Eggers tradita, devota deo qui mortem regit.

source: “He embodies the very concept of death. Emulating Him is a way to approach the source of death.
target: Ipse ipsum conceptum mortis repraesentat. Eum imitari modus est ad fontem mortis accedendi.

source: “This mystic explanation resonates with me the most. Over the years, I’ve heard various interpretations:
target: Haec mystica explanatio maxime mihi consonat. Per annos variae interpretationes audivi:

source: “Some see life and death as opposing mystical concepts. They argue that, just as we stand upright and grow upwards in life, burial upside down signifies the contradiction and connection between life and death.
target: Alii vitam atque mortem ut conceptus mystici contrarii vident. Argumentantur, sicut in vita recti stamus et sursum crescimus, ita sepultura inversa contrarietatem atque nexum inter vitam et mortem significat.

source: “Others believe that true hell isn’t in the spirit world or the Underworld, but deep underground. Descending further symbolizes reaching true hell and returning to the essence of death. Thus, mausoleums are built upside down, reflecting our intention to face hell, worship death, and return to the source. This is the essence and symbol of mysticism.”
target: Alii vero credunt verum infernum non in mundo spirituum aut in inferis esse, sed profunde sub terra. Descensio ulterius significat verum infernum attingere et ad essentiam mortis redire. Itaque mausolea inversa aedificantur, nostra voluntate ostendens ut infernum oppugnemus, mortem colamus, atque ad fontem rediremus. Haec est essentia atque symbolum mysticismi.”

source: Some Beyonders of the Death pathway don’t really approve of the Underworld…
target: Nonnulli Beyonders viae Mortis vere non consentiunt inferis…

source: Can you discover true hell by delving deep underground?
target: Potesne verum infernum detegere per profundam inquisitionem subterraneam?

source: Heh heh, hasn’t anyone informed you that the world we’re on is essentially a planet?
target: Heh heh, num nemo tibi dixit mundum in quo sumus esse re vera planetam?

source: Does this extension reach underground magma and the core?
target: Attingitne haec extensio ad magma subterranea et ad nucleum?

source: Do they believe that’s the genuine hell?
target: Num hoc verum infernum esse censent?

source: Going deeper will traverse the core and the magma, but that’ll merely be the other side of the planet, let alone true hell…
target: Profundius descendendo, nucleum et magma percurreris, sed id solum alteram partem planetae repraesentabit, quanto minus verum infernum…

source: Lumian found himself increasingly entertained as he listened.
target: Lumian se magis ac magis oblectatum invenit, dum auscultabat.

source: Suddenly, he was taken aback.
target: Subito, stupefactus est.

source: What exists on the opposite side of the planet?
target: Quid in altera parte planetae existit?

source: I only know of the Northern and Southern Continents.
target: Solum continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales novi sunt.

source: Considering the time difference, they’re nearly on the same side…
target: Ratione differentiae temporis, paene in eadem parte versantur…

source: If this world is genuinely a planet, there must be another side.
target: Si mundus hic vere planeta sit, alteram partem esse oportet.

source: But I’ve never heard of any continents—just an expansive sea?
target: Sed numquam audivi de continentibus—solum mare vastum extat?

source: Wait, how did those giant fellows from the New City of Silver emerge from the Forsaken Land of the Gods…
target: Exspecta, quomodo illi gigantes ex Nova Urbe Argentea ex Terra Deorum Derelicta apparuerunt…

source: Something must have occurred on the continent on the other side of the planet, abandoned by the deities.
target: Aliquid debet evenisse in continente in altera parte planetae, ab deis derelictum.

source: Could that be why it’s known as the Forsaken Land of the Gods?
target: Num id sit, qua ea vocatur Terra Deorum Derelicta?

source: If I have a chance in the future, I could revisit the New City of Silver and explore the library for books related to the Forsaken Land of the Gods…
target: Si mihi in futurum occasio detur, possum iterum Novam Urbem Argenteam visitare et in bibliotheca libros de Terra Deorum Derelicta quaerere…

source: Lumian reined in his thoughts and continued conversing with Iveljsta for a while.
target: Lumian cogitationes suas moderavit et paulisper cum Iveljsta colloquium continuavit.

source: Eventually, he escorted the former descendant of the Balam Empire’s royal family, a member of the temperance faction, away from this floor.
target: Postremo, comitatus est pristino descendenti familiae regiae Imperii Balam, membro factionis Temperantiae, ex hoc pavimento discedens.

source: Not long after returning to his room, the doll messenger arrived with a response from Madam Magician.
target: Non longe postquam ad cubiculum suum rediit, advenit nuntius ex pupa cum responsione a Domina Magician.

source: “The information and insights you’ve gathered this time are exceptionally valuable. It’s no wonder my spiritual perception guided me to let you visit the New City of Silver after the Hanth Island Demon incident.
target: "Informationes et perspicientiae, quas hoc tempore collegisti, sunt eximie pretiosae. Non mirum est quod perceptio spiritualis mea me duxit ut te Novam Urbem Argenteam visitare post incidentem Demonis Insulae Hanth."

source: “Reflecting on it, your encounter with Naboredisley seemed almost coincidental. You followed the clues to Hanth Island. Hmm, you should grasp the significance, right?
target: "Cogitans, congressus tuus cum Naboredisley paene fortuito apparuit. Indicia secutus es ad Insulam Hanth. Hem, debet significatum tibi esse cognitum, nonne?"

source: “The situation in this matter both reassures me and intensifies my vigilance and anxiety. When that entity stands by our side, these details are incredibly useful. However, He won’t always be with us. When our objectives clash, I can’t fathom what challenges we’ll face. The same goes for you and me.
target: "Res in hac re et me consolatur et vigilantiam ac anxietatem meam auget. Cum illa entitas ad latus nostrum stat, hae singulae res valde utiles sunt. Tamen, ille non semper nobiscum erit. Cum nostra proposita concurrunt, non possum imaginari quae difficultates occurrent. Idem valet inter te et me."

source: “Therefore, Hunters must rely more on their personal growth amidst blood, fire, chaos, and conflict. Many Hunters meet their end, using their bones to forge the Red Priest who conquers all.
target: "Ergo Venatores debent magis inniti suae personalis evolutioni inter sanguinem, ignem, chaos, et conflictum. Multi Venatores intereunt, ossa sua ad conficiendum Rubrum Sacrum, qui omnia superat, utentes."

source: “We’ve already initiated an internal review. It involves a considerable number of individuals and will take a substantial amount of time to complete. Considering your contributions, besides converting the Beyonder characteristic into a Sealed Artifact, you have the option to choose a reward. Pick one out of two. Here are your choices.
target: "Iam internam recognitionem iniciavimus. Multos homines implicat et tempus considerabile ad perficiendum requiret. Consideratis contributionibus tuis, praeterquam proprietatem Beyonder in Artifactum Sigillatam converteris, habes optionem praemium eligendi. Elige unum ex duobus. Ecce optiones tuae."

source: “1: the potion formula for the Hunter pathway’s Sequence 4 Iron-blooded Knight. 2: I’ll assist you in divining clues about the remaining parts of the Abscessed Hand’s body.”
target: "1: formula potionis pro via Venatoris Sequenciae 4, 'Eques Ferreus Sanguinis.' 2: Auxiliabor tibi in divinatione inditiarum de reliquis partibus corporis 'Manus Abscessae.'"
